description: This Kotlin class 'RecipeRepository' acts as a mock data source for recipes, simulating network calls to fetch categories, recipes per category, and search recipes, with dummy data and artificial delays.

classes.name: RecipeRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of a recipe data source, providing categories, recipes, and search functionality with dummy data.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Fetches a list of recipe categories with simulated network delay.

methods.name: getRecipesForCategory
methods.description: Retrieves recipes belonging to a specified category with simulated network delay.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for recipes matching the query string with simulated network delay.
